intro.text: The leader of a crew of eight crooks in Elendel.

items.text: In 342 a heist by Migs' crew went badly wrong, and he shot two constables, who both survived.

The gang barricaded itself overnight in an old pub, and Migs refused to give up even when promised he would not hang. On the morning of Wax's wedding, Wax broke the barricade and turned their fire with a steel bubble while Wayne crept in and punched Migs. When Migs asked why he hadn't just killed them all, Wax said he wasn't worth killing, and Migs surrendered.
